lines.text: Moses gave the Reubenites and Gadites land along the Arnon Valley, and gave half-tribe Manasseh the rest of Gilead and Bashan.
Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, renamed Bashan after himself, calling it Havvoth-jair.
Moses commanded the men of valor to cross over armed ahead of their brothers, while their families and livestock stayed in the cities.
Moses told Caleb not to be afraid of the kingdoms ahead, because the LORD Himself would fight for him.
Moses asked to cross over and see the good land, but the LORD told him to go to the top of Nebo and look.
